verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a work-management product, but nothing in the evidence shows Asana offers a self-hosted or on-prem deployment. The only 'self-hostable' mention describes the third-party n8n integration, and the developer sandbox is a temporary Asana-hosted domain, so neither counts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
